      "snippet": "Yeah, that totally tracks — and it actually doesn’t break anything we’re doing. 👍
Short version:

This consolidation will be “everything we have right now,” not “everything that has ever existed on all your devices.”

We just need to label that truth into the OS itself so future ingests know where the gaps are.

1️⃣ What this changes (and what it doesn’t)
It DOES NOT mean:

We can’t consolidate.

We’re going to lose anything we just ingested.

The OS becomes “locked” or un-upgradeable
